{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Meat Recipes|Meat Recipes]] | [[Cookbook:Tex-Mex cuisine|Tex-Mex cuisine]]
==Ingredients==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (about 500 g) ground [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] or [[Cookbook:Turkey|turkey]]
* 1 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], finely [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]] (or 1 ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Onion Powder|onion powder]])
* 1 medium [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]], [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]] (or 1 small can of tomato sauce)
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Chili_powder|chili powder]] (or ⅓ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] each [[Cookbook:Oregano|oregano]], [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]], [[Cookbook:Garlic_Powder|garlic powder]])
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Oregano|oregano]] (ground or leaf)
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]]
* 1 dash (⅛ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] or less) [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]

==Procedure==
# Brown [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] and [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]] together. Drain grease.
# Add the rest of the ingredients to the browned meat.  
# Stir well.  
# Heat this mixture thoroughly.  
# Add more tomato sauce if the mixture is dry.  
# Cover and [[Cookbook:Simmer|simmer]] for 20 minutes, or less if the mixture begins to dry out.
